Plot the observed data

Source: R/plot_workbook.R
plot_sheet_data.Rd

Draws the recorded response against concentration, with no model fitted. This is the check that the right rows and columns were read from the sheet: the points should reproduce what is on the laboratory form.

Usage

plot_sheet_data(sheet, transform = "sqrt")

Arguments

sheet

An analysis_sheet object from read_analysis_sheet().

transform

Concentration axis spacing, one of "sqrt", "log" or "identity". Match this to the transformation used for the fit.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_sheet_data(read_analysis_sheet(find_workbook(), "Copper Ref (4)"))
} # }
